description: Verkehrszählungen Strassen- und Langsamverkehr is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Luzern: Dienststelle Verkehr und Infrastruktur. Zeigt die Standorte der Verkehrszählungen von motorisiertem Individualverkehr, Velo- und Fussgängern mittels Verkehrszählern oder Lichtsignalanlagen im Kanton Luzern. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Luzern: Dienststelle Verkehr und Infrastruktur. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
